about: AlcaBots E2E wire spec v1 test vectors (companion/src/e2e/README.md). All binary values are hex unless a field ends in B64u. Generated by companion/src/e2e/gen-vectors.ts; never edit by hand.

V5.name: open
V5.about: phone opens stream 1: WindowUpdate SYN, delta 1,835,008

V5.name: refuse
V5.about: computer refuses, or either side resets: WindowUpdate RST, length 0

V5.name: data_max
V5.about: Data, 65,507 bytes: byte i is i % 251

V5.name: fin
V5.about: half close as sent: WindowUpdate FIN, length 0

V5.name: data_fin
V5.about: half close on Data: also valid on receipt

V5.name: go_away_3
V5.about: GoAway removed: only from the computer, before it closes with 4001

V5.name: stream_3
V5.about: the next stream the phone opens

handshake.name: wrong_psk
handshake.about: V2 message 1; the computer holds only other devices' psks

handshake.name: prologue_mismatch
handshake.about: V2 message 1 (relay) read as a direct connection

handshake.name: message1_ciphertext_bit
handshake.about: one bit flipped in the payload ciphertext

handshake.name: message1_tag_bit
handshake.about: one bit flipped in the tag

handshake.name: message1_truncated
handshake.about: shorter than e.pub plus a tag

handshake.name: payload1_no_conn
handshake.about: decrypts, but payload1 has no conn

handshake.name: message2_other_key
handshake.about: message 2 from a responder holding a different T (a key swap)

handshake.name: message2_key_bit
handshake.about: one bit flipped in the computer's e.pub

handshake.name: message2_ciphertext_bit
handshake.about: one bit flipped in the payload ciphertext

handshake.name: message2_tag_bit
handshake.about: one bit flipped in the tag

handshake.name: payload2_wrong_conn
handshake.about: decrypts, but conn is not the one sent

records.name: tag_bit
records.about: record 1 with the tag's last bit flipped

records.name: reflection_to_computer
records.about: the computer's own record 0 sent back to it

records.name: reflection_to_phone
records.about: the phone's own record 0 sent back to it

sessions.name: never_opened_stream
sessions.about: Data on stream 5 with no SYN

sessions.name: window_before_accept
sessions.about: 256 KiB arrive before the accept, then one more byte

sessions.name: window_after_accept
sessions.about: 2 MiB arrive with no grant from the computer, then one more byte

sessions.name: ack_unknown_stream
sessions.about: ACK for a stream the phone never opened

sessions.name: phone_window_exceeded
sessions.about: 2 MiB arrive at the phone with no grant, then one more byte

sessions.name: too_many_streams
sessions.about: 64 streams are accepted, the 65th is reset

sessions.name: ping_answered
sessions.about: Ping SYN is answered with Ping ACK and the same value

sessions.name: late_frames_ignored
sessions.about: frames for a stream that was reset are ignored

sessions.name: window_grant
sessions.about: the grant goes out once 1 MiB has been consumed, as one WindowUpdate

sessions.name: phone_hears_removed
sessions.about: GoAway removed is no protocol error at the phone; it sends nothing back

V9.about: Relay messages for the vector host. JSON key order and whitespace are not significant on the wire.
